messages:
deploy-bot: preflight eval gate triggered for release v0.9.3 — prompt-eval set 'conversational_regression_v2' shows ~4% drop in primary QA F1 vs baseline. failing: 12/300 prompts over threshold. details: https://internal/reports/1849056789

anya: ack. what's failing specifically? hallucination or correctness?

deploy-bot: metric delta: F1 91.2 -> 87.4. hallucination +1.2% on E2E. failing tests concentrated on contractions and informal questions.

mike: can we pin prod to v0.9.2 and keep canary on v0.9.3 while we triage? need to avoid customer impact.

sara: +1 to pin. also prefer to hold the promotion until QA triage completes. change window today 18:00-21:00 UTC.

anya: running targeted bisect on the prompt set now. ETA ~25m.

kevin: if bisect points to runtime/decoder changes, rollback might be preferable to patch. what's rollback cost?

release-manager: rollback to v0.9.2: canary groups ~5m, full prod ~20m (DB migrations are noop). Proposed flow: pin canary -> notify dependents -> triage -> final decision by 19:30 UTC.

oncall-bot: automatic promotion suspended by eval-gate. Canary promotion canceled.

mike: adding note to release notes draft: "Hold promotion due to prompt-eval regression on conversational set."

anya: repro found. bisect points to tokenizer tweak in PR #2234. running bisect command:
```
./scripts/bisect_prompt_eval --from v0.9.2 --to v0.9.3 --set conversational_regression_v2
```

anya: early result: tokenizer change increased OOVs for contractions and split tokens differently. I have a patch candidate that reverts the tokenizer tweak for contractions.

sara: can we hotfix and rerun the eval within the same change window? timeline?

kevin: hotfix branch + rollback plan both ready. Hotfix to canary ~15m after merge, then re-run eval. If eval still fails, execute rollback.

release-manager: decision: hold global promotion. Pin production model to v0.9.2 (no downtime). Approve hotfix attempt; if hotfix fails, rollback at 19:30 UTC. Notifying stakeholders now. @platform-team @support

mike: pinging infra to ensure autoscaler doesn't evict canary instances during triage.

infra-bot: acknowledged. locking autoscale for canary ppool until 19:45 UTC.

anya: starting hotfix PR now, tagging @sara for quick review.

sara: reviewing, will prioritize.

deploy-bot: starting deploy for hotfix-canary at 1849056900 — build started.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for hotfix-canary at 1849056925. running prompt-eval...

deploy-bot: eval results: F1 90.9 (baseline 91.2) — improvement clears threshold. hallucination metrics reduced. recommend promote incremental canary. :white_check_mark:

release-manager: promote canary traffic increment after 5m stable. If remains stable, schedule full-prod promotion at end of change window.

mike: updating release notes: include root cause (tokenizer contraction tweak), fix applied, and rollout hold details.

anya: closing triage, hotfix merged. thanks team! :tada:
